profile.headline: Associate Frontend Developer | React & JavaScript | Transitioning into Software Engineering
profile.summary:
I am a Frontend Developer with a background in corporate administrative operations, transitioning into software engineering to build high-impact web applications.

Having spent years managing front-desk logistics and client workflows, I bring a unique, user-first perspective to frontend development. I focus on engineering clean, modular user interfaces using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, with hands-on experience building everything from public-facing intake platforms to secure administrative data dashboards. I am detail-oriented, eager to continuously learn new frameworks, and ready to bring a dedicated problem-solving mindset to a collaborative engineering team.

Looking ahead, my long-term career goal is to transition into cloud engineering. I am actively expanding my technical foundation to bridge the gap between frontend architecture and modern cloud infrastructure.

Technical Skills: React • Vite • JavaScript • Tailwind CSS • Semantic HTML & CSS • Git/GitHub • REST API Integration

positions.title: Frontend Developer (Independent)
positions.description:
• Engineered responsive, multi-page web applications using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
• Optimized data-fetching lifecycles and component state management to implement features like client-side state persistence.
• Built dual-sided platform systems, integrating custom API-handling contact forms and secure administrative management flows.

positions.title: Receptionist
positions.description:
• Managed corporate invoicing and inventory management pipelines, identifying and resolving operational workflow bottlenecks.
• Maintained high-precision data logs across internal software platforms to ensure data integrity and documentation accuracy.
• Supported system security protocols by auditing user access permissions and coordinating cross-functional team logistics.

positions.title: Personal Care Assistant
positions.description:
• Maintained high-precision adherence to healthcare scheduling and medication logs.
• Coordinated client transportation logistics and provided specialized personal advocacy.

positions.title: UI/UX Researcher & Web Developer (Volunteer)
positions.description:
• Partnered directly with the non-profit CEO to establish an online presence, converting fragmented ideas into a clean digital strategy via Wix.
• Conducted deep-dive user behavioral research and audited layout accessibility standards to optimize volunteer intake and donation pipelines.

positions.title: UI Researcher (Contract)
positions.description:
• Executed complete visual design audits on unorganized legacy web layouts to build a cohesive, unified design system via Wix.
• Collaborated directly with the CEO to align target business objectives with interface scalability and cross-browser responsiveness.

positions.title: Front Desk Attendant
positions.description:
• Managed administrative communications, tenant requests, and digital work order tracking software.
• Spearheaded inventory supply operations and supported vendor invoicing pipelines.

positions.title: Receptionist/Office Assitant
positions.description:
• Oversaw day-to-day facilities operations, managing visitor intake registries, incoming communications, and mailroom distribution.
• Managed internal work orders via Outlook ticketing infrastructure to support cross-functional building requirements.

positions.title: Logistics/Fulfillment
positions.description:
• Coordinated time-sensitive shipment tracking, inventory sorting, and accurate residential delivery staging.
• Assisted with on-site store layout transformations during a high-scale retail location remodeling project.

positions.title: Front Desk Receptionist
positions.description: • Facilitated clinical patient intake, automated scheduling flows, and secure electronic health document entry.
